## Statements

- Stated by harness (hermes-context-files, Priority system): Hermes loads one project context file per session, first match wins: .hermes.md, then AGENTS.override.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md. A .hermes.md hides AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md.
- Stated by harness (hermes-security, Approval Modes, single_query_mode key): A hermes chat -q run has nobody to answer approval prompts, so by default it denies any command the approval check flags and the agent must find another path.
- Stated by harness (hermes-configuration, Reasoning effort, ultra clamping): Hermes clamps a requested reasoning effort down to the strongest level the route accepts, never up; ultra always maps to the route's top level.
- Stated by harness (hermes-security, Approval Modes, off row and YOLO Mode): Passing --yolo or setting approvals.mode: off removes every command approval prompt; use it only in a disposable or isolated environment.
